difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the preceding construction the category C_{X/Lambda} is fibred over the Zariski site of X (source lines 4249-4253). The proof gives the explicit base change: for an object U -> A of the category and a morphism U' -> U of the Zariski site one takes the composite U' -> U -> A as the new object and verifies directly that the resulting morphism is strongly cartesian over the site.
